labeling_method: Labels and rationales assigned from actual source coverage before any A/C predictions, independently of router outputs. One analyst; no second human annotator or inter-rater reliability claim.
ambiguity_definition: Single best available source under the original router descriptions: covered domain documentation takes vectorstore precedence over possible generic web answers; private store records require SQL; recent or out-of-domain public information requires web_search.
prior_exposure: Prior two-question A/B diagnostics were already known. These 15 exact questions are new; V2 overlaps the prior retrieval-grading topic. This is a bounded diagnostic, not a pristine unseen benchmark.

criteria_C.vectorstore: Documentation on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic RAG patterns with LangGraph, and RAGAS evaluation.
criteria_C.sql: SQLite online store: product names, categories and prices; sales quantities, dates and countries; product reviews, ratings, review dates and comments.
criteria_C.web_search: current events, recent facts, or anything not covered by the other two sources.

protocol.changed_factor: Only Choice criteria values. Keep full state descriptions, questions, instructions, labels/order, model/checkpoint, device and model parameters identical.
protocol.execution_order: Round 0 unscored warmups on all 15 inputs and both variants; rounds 1-2 measured, alternating A/C first by case and round. No batching/concurrent model calls.
protocol.latency_scope: Real SDK.predict plus MPS synchronize. Validation audit, expected-label comparison, normalization, CPU token copying, logging and result writes excluded.
protocol.decision_margin: Top-1 probability minus runner-up from returned 4-decimal probabilities; also record expected-source probability minus strongest other source.
protocol.stop_on: Any guard/encoding mismatch, inference error, CPU fallback, source/baseline integrity failure or frozen-manifest modification. Never adapt criteria or labels after predictions.
protocol.interpretation: Count 15 unique questions, not repeated calls, for accuracy. Systematic failure on clear single-source questions warrants keeping Choice experimental; this diagnostic cannot establish broad production accuracy.
